title: Retire unused delivery ceremony after no-gates decision
body: Operator 2026-11-07 "wypierdol bramki po prostu koduj": the lead skill now defaults to push+PR+auto-merge on Check. Remove or shrink the unused ceremony code paths (krn slice run, krn deliver review/judge-status requirements, krn review panel as default, red-first in verify) or make them opt-in, and delete their lead traps; fix krn-handoff/krn-retro to match. Measure: one-file fix median from first edit to merge (PR #251 took ~3 min).
